concept: Global Accelerator: static anycast IPs and fast regional failover
tests: Choosing a service for a global TCP app with static anycast IPs and instant failover.
expected: AWS Global Accelerator: static anycast IPs, traffic over the AWS backbone to the nearest healthy regional endpoint, fast failover independent of DNS TTL. Triggers: "TCP", "static anycast IP", "instant failover", "nearest healthy Regional endpoint".
why_not: CloudFront optimizes HTTP content; Route 53 failover depends on DNS TTL; a single ALB is regional.
